grammar.title: Complex Sentence Structures: Hypothetical Period (Periodo Ipotetico)
grammar.explanation: Italian has three types of hypothetical sentences (if-clauses). Type 1 (reality): 'Se piove, resto a casa' (If it rains, I stay home) - present + present. Type 2 (possibility): 'Se avessi più tempo, farei volontariato' (If I had more time, I would volunteer) - imperfect subjunctive + conditional. Type 3 (impossibility/past): 'Se avessimo riciclato di più, non avremmo inquinato tanto' (If we had recycled more, we wouldn't have polluted so much) - pluperfect subjunctive + past conditional. Type 2 and 3 are essential for discussing hypothetical social and environmental scenarios.

quiz.question: In a Type 2 hypothetical sentence, what tenses are used?
How do you say 'If I were a volunteer, I would help the community'?
options: Se sono volontario, aiuto la comunità.
Se fossi un volontario, aiuterei la comunità.
Se sarò volontario, aiuterò la comunità.
Se ero volontario, aiutavo la comunità.
